subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: The Elixir
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Elixir.

hook.text: Prometheus brought fire to humanity. Moses carried stone tablets. Heroes bring gifts that change the world.

buildup.text: The elixir is the boon the hero carries back—a cure, a truth, a power that heals the community.

discovery.text: In myth, the elixir often has a cosmic price. Odin gave an eye for wisdom. Knowledge costs something.

twist.text: Some elixirs are dangerous. Nuclear power came from physics just as fire came from the gods—with risk.

climax.text: The elixir completes the cycle. The hero's personal journey becomes a collective gift.

punchline.text: What you earn, you owe the world.

quiz.question: What is the 'elixir' in the hero's journey?
options: The boon the hero brings back to the community
